## Load the required library for reading Excel files

```{r}
library(dplyr)
infant <- readxl::read_excel("infant.xlsx")
infant <- infant |>
  filter(smoke != 9 & age > 18 & race != 10) |>
  select(-(id:outcome), -sex) |>
  mutate(
    wt = ifelse(wt == 999, NA, wt),
    wt = wt * 0.4536,
    # This is the corrected line with backticks added
    `Ethnic group` = recode_factor(
      race,
      `6` = "Latino",
      `7` = "Black",
      `8` = "Asian",
      `9` = "Mixed",
      .default = "White"
    ),
    smoke = recode_factor(
      smoke,
      `1` = "currently",
      `2` = "until pregnancy",
      `3` = "used to",
      `0` = "never"
    ),
    gestation = ifelse(gestation == 999, NA, gestation)
  )
```

# 1. Basic Scatter Plot

```{r}
plot(bwt ~ wt,
     data = infant,
     main = "Basic Scatter Plot",
     xlab = "Mother's Weight (kg)",
     ylab = "Infant Birth Weight (g)")
```

# 2. Enhanced Scatter Plot with Colors and Legend

```{r}
smoke_colors <- c("blue", "orange", "red", "grey1")
```

```{r}
plot(bwt ~ wt,
     data = infant,
     main = "Infant Weight vs. Mother's Weight by Smoking Status",
     xlab = "Mother's Weight (kg)",
     ylab = "Infant Birth Weight (g)",
     pch = 19, # Use solid circles
     col = smoke_colors[infant$smoke] # Color the points based on the 'smoke' variable
     )
legend("topright", 
       legend = levels(infant$smoke),
       inset=c(0,0),
       col = smoke_colors,
       pch = 19,
       title = "Smoking Status",
       cex = 0.75)
```
# 3. Formatted Bar Chart
```{r}
smoke_counts <- table(infant$smoke)
```

```{r}
barplot(smoke_counts,
        main = "Distribution of Smoking Status Among Mothers",
        ylab = "Number of Mothers",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgoldenrod1", "salmon", "lightgreen"),
        ylim = c(0, max(smoke_counts) * 1.2) # Set y-axis limit 20% higher than the tallest bar
        )

```
# 4. Box Plot with Gridlines

```{r}
boxplot(bwt ~ smoke,
        data = infant,
        main = "Infant Birth Weight by Mother's Smoking Status",
        xlab = "Mother's Smoking Status",
        ylab = "Infant Birth Weight (g)",
        col = c("lightblue", "lightyellow", "lightpink", "palegreen"),
        las = 1 # Make the y-axis labels horizontal
        )
grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL, col = "gray", lty = "dotted")
```
